title: Hippias
summary: Raleigh names Hippias in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Hippias, a sonne of Pisistratus, who gouerned Athens after his father, and who was presented to Darius after he gaue ouer the citie. The printed spelling is kept. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book III, Part I, Chapter V, §. VI, sig. 407a–407b
